subject: Order delayed in transit
body: I ordered a Smart Fitness Watch last week and the courier tracking has not moved in two days. When will my shipment arrive?

subject: Package marked delivered but missing
body: My tracking says the monitor was delivered on November 25, but there is no package at my front door or with neighbors.

subject: Refund for cancelled hub order
body: My order ORD-105 was cancelled earlier this week. Please check if I am eligible for a refund back to my original payment method.

subject: Incorrect invoice amount billed
body: I just checked my invoice for order ORD-102 and the transaction shows $20 more than the checkout total. Can you review this billing issue?

subject: Duplicate charge on my card
body: I was charged twice for my 4K Ultra HD Webcam order ORD-106. Please investigate the duplicate payment transaction.

subject: Damaged product arrived broken
body: The wireless mouse I received has a cracked shell and the scroll wheel is broken right out of the box. Can I get a refund?

subject: Mobile app crashes at checkout
body: Every time I try to apply a promo code in your mobile app, the application freezes and crashes immediately with a fatal error.

subject: Cannot log in to account
body: I keep getting a login failure and a 500 server error whenever I enter my password on the customer portal.

subject: Standing desk converter defect after a month
body: The lift mechanism on my Standing Desk Converter has a hardware malfunction and stopped locking. Am I still eligible for a refund on order ORD-107?

subject: Gift wrapping and corporate bulk orders
body: Hello! Do you offer custom gift wrapping or holiday discount codes for corporate team gifts next month?

subject: Refund eligibility before shipment arrives
body: I changed my mind about the headphones in order ORD-101. Since it already shipped, am I eligible for an automatic refund right now?

subject: Urgent unauthorized charge on unknown order
body: I see a suspicious transaction for order ORD-999 that I never placed. Please escalate this immediately to a fraud specialist for review.
